tools.name: get_prayer_request_guide
tools.description: Internal guide for new prayer requests. Confirm fresh location and other missing inputs; reuse previous settings only if explicitly requested. Do not quote the guide to the user.

tools.name: list_prayer_institutions
tools.description: Identify and disambiguate institutional requests e.g. شعبہ فلکیات دعوتِ اسلامی, Shoba Falakiyat, Astronomy Department Dawat e Islami. Only registry labels; official endorsement NOT verified.

tools.name: find_location
tools.description: Find candidate cities and coordinates using a free geocoding service. If multiple cities are returned, ask user which location is intended; never invent coordinates.

tools.name: get_daily_prayer_times
tools.description: Fresh DAILY calculation after confirming location for this request, date, fiqh and elevation. Returns a single selected time per prayer, context and footer. Render times[].time only; default seconds, internal careful_minutes only if requested. Show actual context, direct print notice and follow-up q

tools.name: get_monthly_prayer_times
tools.description: Fresh MONTHLY calculation after current-request location and inputs are confirmed. Render days[].times[].time only, context, direct print notice and closing question. Default seconds; internal careful_minutes only when explicitly requested. No duplicate minute column or tool narration. Institution m

tools.name: get_timezone_info
tools.description: Resolve IANA timezone, UTC offset and daylight saving offset for a location on a given date.

tools.name: resolve_prayer_context
tools.description: Resolve date-specific timezone and automatic or manual elevation for the user's confirmed coordinates. Use before prayer calculation to resolve confirmed current-request location and metadata; no prayer times calculated.

tools.name: create_timetable_download
tools.description: Generate an actual PDF or Excel file and return an embedded binary MCP resource. For annual leave month unset; for a day specify month/day. tools.name: get_department_info
tools.description: Return only configured sourced information and verification status; never invent contact details.

tools.name: search_prayer_faq
tools.description: Search editable knowledge base; answer only supported matches. For missing answers offer published contact information; public feedback is disabled.
